name: Sweet Ambrosia: Banish self to recover 3 damage from the champion
notes: Field items with an activated ability are NOT reachable via a plain myField-N!FSM! click -- ActionMap's "myField" case (GrandArchiveSim/Custom/GameLogic.php:1289-1296) only handles attack declarations (BeginCombatPhase) for ALLY/CHAMPION objects, and silently no-ops for anything else (confirmed empirically: the click reported success but left the object un-banished and the champion's Damage unchanged). Sweet Ambrosia's own ability is instead offered as a fast-action MZMAYCHOOSE opportunity the moment the turn player attempts to pass (GetPlayableOpportunityChoices -> GetPlayableFastAbilities, GrandArchiveSim/Custom/OpportunityLogic.php), answered with the encoded "{mzID}@Activate-{abilityIndex}@{label}" choice string -- same shape as tariff-ring-attack-tax's response, but reachable immediately on P1's own turn 1 pass since Sweet Ambrosia has no phase restriction (unlike Tariff Ring's opponent-recollection-only timing).
